entities.summary: Konstantin Konstantinovich Pervukhin was a Ukrainian and Russian Impressionist landscape painter, writer and photographer; associated with the Peredvizhniki. Konstantin Pervukhin was a painters & sculptors from Kharkiv (1863-06-02, Kharkiv–1915-02-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
